import sys
from itertools import permutations

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    index = 0
    t = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    
    results = []
    
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(data[index])
        c = int(data[index + 1])
        q = int(data[index + 2])
        index += 3
        
        p = list(map(int, data[index:index + n]))
        index += n
        
        queries = []
        for _ in range(q):
            i = int(data[index]) - 1
            j = int(data[index + 1])
            queries.append((i, j))
            index += 2
        
        # Generate all possible permutations with cost <= c
        seen = set()
        for l in range(n):
            for r in range(l, min(n, l + c + 1)):
                rev_p = p[:]
                rev_p[l:r+1] = reversed(rev_p[l:r+1])
                seen.add(tuple(rev_p))
        
        sorted_perms = sorted(seen)
        
        for i, j in queries:
            if j > len(sorted_perms):
                results.append(-1)
            else:
                results.append(sorted_perms[j-1][i])
    
    print("\n".join(map(str, results)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
